reasons: Claimed status is compliant and no redline or comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.

Cited clauses support compliance: 12.3 expressly disclaims any exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment by Customer, and 2.1 confirms no minimum quantity or purchase commitment and that declining further Order Forms is not a breach — this meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer).

Clause 12.4 restrains Vendor only and benefits Customer, correctly excluded per the detection guidance; remaining 'exclusive' usages (non-exclusive licence, non-exclusive remedies, exclusive jurisdiction) are not Customer-side exclusivity.
Deterministic check confirms no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains, consistent with the rationale.
